comment: SITES.md step 1, and the second site on the 120x120 world map to get a room behind its door. Walked the whole way rather than started by hand: onto the door cell on the world map, in at the west gate, past the fingerpost, in at the Eight Hours, round the room, a night in a bed, and back out to the square places.RESTWELL_STEP names. The point of walking it is that a site door is a *placeholder replaced* - journey.world_map drops the two inert events worldmap.json ships for Restwell and builds real ones on the same cells - and nothing but arriving proves the swap landed on the right squares. It is also the check that the inn mechanic, which is the thing Restwell exists to prove generalises, actually recovers the party.

steps.label: Restwell has two door events, one per cell of its Town A stamp
and neither of them is a placeholder any more - they carry no site note, because they are this game's events now and not the world map's
